summary: GSK plc filed a Form 6-K reporting its purchase of its own ordinary shares (31p each) through Citigroup Global Markets under an existing buyback program announced on May 11, 2026. The purchases aggregated 1,101,889 shares over five consecutive trading days (June 15-19, 2026) at prices ranging from 1,906.00 GBp to 1,988.50 GBp per share at a weighted average of roughly 1,951.5 GBp. The shares will be held in treasury, bringing total treasury shares to 269,826,411 and voting rights to 4,046,440,349 (treasury shares representing 6.67% of voting rights). This is a routine open-market share buyback, part of a non-discretionary mandate. Watch for continued buyback pace and potential impact on earnings per share.
